text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After hearing that Nice Nature was seen at 
the riverbank, I went looking for her—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hah, hah... hah...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"This is no good, I need to... think more 
carefully while running..."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Also, your mood. You're slumping, Nature. 
Don't be so gloomy, cheer up more~.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Come on, remember, remember. How do I 
usually run again?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"The Kyoto Shimbun Hai... You lacked 
confidence, but you gave it everything 
because you had to run."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...So, we've decided, right? At the Kokura 
Kinen—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I just need to take it one step at a time, 
staying true to myself... and keep moving 
forward, right?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Even if I don't know whether it'll reach 
or not...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...I'll face it head-on, with everything 
I've got."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, I can't exactly puff out my chest 
and say I'm brimming with confidence just 
yet, but...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Even so, there's no way to run away. 
That's why I will definitely, with Teio――
choice_data_list: You can do it, Nice Nature!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Trainer-san, you always spoil me 
like this~

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You can't be doing that~. If you're like 
that, someone like me will just keep 
clinging to you forever... wait.
choice_data_list: Good work on the extra practice!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Whoa!? H-Hey, since when were you there!?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah... no, you don't have to say it. If I 
hear it, it'll probably just break my 
heart anyway.
choice_data_list: What training are you doing right now?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Well, I guess you could call it 
training. Yeah, I suppose it is.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I just want to gain whatever edge I can to 
win. So I'm seeing if there's any weapon 
that suits me.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
The home stretch really is the crucial 
part, huh. You've gotta make sure you 
close it out on that final straight.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
3,000 meters on top of all that... haha. 
When you really think about it, that's 
crazy long.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
3,000m... If you don't accurately judge 
the timing to make your move, it will be 
difficult to even contend in the 
homestretch.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I want Nice Nature to run freely and 
without pressure, so she can wear her 
usual bright smile after the race.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Pardon?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Just 'do your best'... That's such 
wishy-washy advice..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had only meant to pump myself up 
internally, but the words slipped out of 
my mouth before I realized it.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Pfft, heh-heh-heh... Ahahaha! Come on, 
really! Don't make that "I blew it" face!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... Yeah, you're right. Let's do our 
best.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
If there's no way out, then the only way 
is forward.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, do you have a little time to hang 
out with me right now?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Nature-san's gonna give it her all. So I 
was kinda hoping you'd watch over me, or 
something like that.
choice_data_list:
Actually, I was hoping to ask you the same 
thing

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Fuha, you really are such a good sport.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"The harder I work, the higher your hopes 
can be for getting a trophy, right, 
Trainer?"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ahahahaha!
